SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%Y-%m') as month, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%x-W%v') as week, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%x-W%v') ORDER BY week

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(pr.purchase_platform,''), '未填写') as name, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(pr.purchase_platform,''), '未填写') ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN pr.purchase_channel = 'OFFLINE' THEN '线下' ELSE '线上' END as name, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY CASE WHEN pr.purchase_channel = 'OFFLINE' THEN '线下' ELSE '线上' END ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(COALESCE(pr.purchase_time, pr.create_time)) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '凌晨(0-6点)' WHEN HOUR(COALESCE(pr.purchase_time, pr.create_time)) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN '上午(6-12点)' WHEN HOUR(COALESCE(pr.purchase_time, pr.create_time)) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN '下午(12-18点)' ELSE '晚上(18-24点)' END as name, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY CASE WHEN HOUR(COALESCE(pr.purchase_time, pr.create_time)) BETWEEN 0 AND 5 THEN '凌晨(0-6点)' WHEN HOUR(COALESCE(pr.purchase_time, pr.create_time)) BETWEEN 6 AND 11 THEN '上午(6-12点)' WHEN HOUR(COALESCE(pr.purchase_time, pr.create_time)) BETWEEN 12 AND 17 THEN '下午(12-18点)' ELSE '晚上(18-24点)' END ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pr.total_price),0) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as order_count, COALESCE(AVG(pr.total_price),0) as average_item_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.purchase_channel = 'OFFLINE' THEN 0 ELSE pr.total_price END),0) as online_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pr.purchase_channel = 'OFFLINE' THEN pr.total_price ELSE 0 END),0) as offline_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%Y') as year, SUM(pr.total_price) as total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)) as count, ROUND(SUM(pr.total_price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(pr.order_id, pr.purchase_id)), 0), 2) as average_amount FROM purchase_record pr WHERE pr.deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pr.purchase_date, '%Y') ORDER BY year
